verdict.rationale: Square offers an official Model Context Protocol server (square-docs-14, square-probe-4) enabling AI agents/LLMs to interact with Square APIs via natural language, plus an llms.txt for AI discoverability (square-probe-1). However, there's no evidence of a native natural-language interface within Square's own dashboard/POS for everyday users—the MCP is a developer-facing integration tool, not a built-in NL command experience.
